# Thirty-Sixth Parallel LLC

> Thirty-Sixth Parallel LLC is a New Mexico company that plans to provide psilocybin services under the New Mexico Medical Psilocybin Program once it is licensed. New Mexico services are pending licensure. The name comes from the 36th parallel, the line of latitude that crosses northern New Mexico.

## Key facts

- Status: New Mexico services pending licensure under the New Mexico Medical Psilocybin Program, and New Mexico consultation requests not open yet
- Owner: Dr. Anne Metz, a licensed professional counselor. She does not hold a New Mexico psilocybin license
- Other businesses: Dr. Metz also owns Anne Metz LLC (https://annemetz.com), a counseling practice, and Satura Practice (Downstream Billing LLC), which provides billing and credentialing training for rural New Mexico clinicians. Anne Metz LLC does not provide psilocybin services. All psilocybin services are provided through Thirty-Sixth Parallel LLC under the laws of the state where the provider is licensed
- New Mexico's program is medical and expected to begin in January 2027. Under the proposed rules, every participant needs a qualifying diagnosis: treatment-resistant depression, a substance use disorder (including cannabis or nicotine use disorders), PTSD, or end-of-life care
- Contact: thirtysixthparallel@gmail.com
